title: Review orbit collection flashlight script
objective: Review Builder's orbit collection implementation before commit; identify correctness bugs, simulator API risks, validation gaps, and any required Builder fixes.
instructions: Take a code-review/QA stance. Findings first, ordered by severity, with file and line references.

Focus on the new run_orbit_collection.py teleop/render behavior: gamepad polling, ray target selection and fallback, orbit pose math, pose restoration, co-located light controls, RGB/depth capture, MP4 output, and JSON validation.
Check whether the script avoids unwanted generated files in the repo and whether the README instructions match actual behavior.
Run non-simulator checks that are safe locally, including syntax/import validation and JSON validation. Do not run simulator-dependent commands.
Do not modify product code. If fixes are needed, describe exact required changes for Builder.
expected_outputs: ResultPacket with clear pass/fail summary, findings, tests run, residual live-sim validation requirements, and recommendation: send back to Builder, proceed to Git-master, or stop.
definition_of_done: All changed/created files from Builder are reviewed.
Non-simulator checks are run or explicitly blocked with reason.
Any blocking issues include exact file/line references and proposed fix direction.
